entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: An information element that may be included in messages when the UE is not in NB-N1 mode, both UE and network support RACS, and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.

entities.name: UE not in NB-N1 mode
entities.description: Condition that the UE is not operating in NB-N1 mode.

entities.name: RACS supported by UE and network
entities.description: Condition that both the UE and the network support RACS (Radio Access Capability Signaling).

entities.name: Network needs to assign UE radio capability ID
entities.description: Condition that the network requires to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.

relations.description: Inclusion of UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition that UE is not in NB-N1 mode.
Inclusion of UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition that both UE and network support RACS.
Inclusion of UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition that network needs to assign a UE radio capability ID.
